clauses.text: I like the open space here
the counter has two dishes on it.
Your partner is at the serving point.
You should have used a bowl earlier,
there is still time to finish.
Do not pick up that onion;
that final trip was too slow.
There is one behind the player.
use it, then wait by the pot.
You picked up an onion, and your partner took the empty bowl.
That extra trip was a mistake.
I prefer the pot near the dishes;
Your turn toward the counter was smart;
You ought to have left the onion for me;
it is on the far counter now.
Please do not block this path
the pot beside you needs a tomato.
take it to the serving point.
